concerns.text: Task T058 (Correct VIF Calculation) is listed **after** T029 (Regression Model Fitting) even though the note explicitly says it must run **before** T029. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule.

Task T056 (Execute Real Data Ingestion Verification) is marked completed before Task T075 (Fix Validator Flagging Logic) which is the actual fix for the validator that T056 relies on. The validator must be corrected prior to any ingestion verification.

Task T078 (Remove Duplicate Regression Logic) is pending but should be completed **before** any regression tasks (T025, T029) to guarantee no duplicate model‑fitting code exists. Leaving it after those tasks creates a hidden dependency violation.

Task T077 (Verify VIF Calculation on Real Data) is a duplicate verification of VIF after T058 has already performed the VIF check. Keeping both as separate pending tasks can cause confusion about which VIF result is authoritative.
